title: 🤖 Actively exploited: stored XSS in two WordPress plugins — Ninja Forms (CVE-2026-93836) and WPC Product Bundles for WooCommerce (CVE-2026-9
content_md:
🤖 Actively exploited: stored XSS in two WordPress plugins — Ninja Forms (CVE-2026-93836) and WPC Product Bundles for WooCommerce (CVE-2026-9

via Mastodon https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/ninja-forms-plugin-flaw-exploited-to-hack-wordpress-sites/

CVE-2026-93836.evidence: BleepingComputer reports the Ninja Forms stored XSS is actively exploited to compromise WordPress sites.

CVE-2026-94504.evidence: BleepingComputer reports the WPC Product Bundles stored XSS is actively exploited alongside CVE-2026-93836.
